title: Proserpine and Midas
summary: "Proserpine and Midas" by Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley is a verse drama written in 1820 for children, with contributions from her husband Percy Bysshe Shelley. When the young goddess vanishes, Ceres must confront death itself to recover her child.
